page.overview:
Who is Samuel Freedle?

Samuel Freedle was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, as a commander, he was the commanding officer of Starbase Trailer Twenty-Nine. On stardate 41734.4, he received an order about the Romulan Neutral Zone patrol schedule from Commodore Richard K. Berman of Starfleet Command. (, okudagram)
